name: Men's Tech Race Vest
shortDescription: The mesh race vest was one of the initial products Ron pioneered back in the early 1970’s alongside the split race short. Product at the time wasn’t designed for purpose. Cotton vests were staple items worn to run in, wh...
description: The mesh race vest was one of the initial products Ron pioneered back in the early 1970’s alongside the split race short. Product at the time wasn’t designed for purpose. Cotton vests were staple items worn to run in, which held onto sweat and became heavy; the very antithesis of what you wanted. Through research, experience and a desire to make a vest that you could actually run and perform in Ron set about producing what runners needed. Lightweight, breathable and high wicking fabrics were sourced and produced resulting in the mesh running vest. Today, whilst fabrics have evolved, the principles of what Ron pioneered over 50 years ago can be found in our Tech Race Vest. It is the lightest and most technical vest we have ever produced - 51 grams (size medium). We have included bonded seams across the whole product, which are free of all stitching and give a light, clean finish. The back features a different mesh structure fabric, which allows for maximum breathability and comfort. Whilst the racer back shaping is designed to not interfere with arm movement or cause any rub of the shoulder blades.

Light, breathable and made for all types of hill day. description: Made from recycled yarns these lightweight shorts, with stretch panels, are a perfect short for putting in the miles. Running is freedom and movement, which is exactly where our thinking for these shorts started. When you’re looking to speed up you don’t want shorts that get in your way – the Tech 4.5"Short is built to let you move – a redefinition of the split short from the brand that invented them. Light as a feather and minimal, it has exactly what you need, and nothing you don’t. A simple drawstring waistband and ventilation provide mile after mile comfort, one lightweight zipped security pocket adds practicality but not bulk. Engineered from our eco-conscious, breathable, high-wicking fabric in recycled yarn. Reflective strips help keep you safe.

description: 7" stretch short with storage for long runs and thigh grip features for uphill efforts. This short is all about 2 things: comfort over any distance and storage. These 7" stretch shorts ensure comfort and ample storage, with 2 thigh pockets, 3 mesh stash pockets, and 1 zip pocket, ideal for long runs. A stretch short will minimise chafing, and this is why many experienced runners chose this type of short.

name: Women's Tech All-Terrain 5" Twin Short
shortDescription: For distance runners, these 5” shorts offer ample storage with 3 mesh stash pockets, and 1 zip pocket—no waist pack needed. All Terrain short is a go to for hill days of all distances, with secure storage, comfort first ...
description: For distance runners, these 5” shorts offer ample storage with 3 mesh stash pockets, and 1 zip pocket—no waist pack needed. All Terrain short is a go to for hill days of all distances, with secure storage, comfort first design and optimal breathability. Made for distance runners who love to wear a 5” short and want the flexibility to carry stuff without having to take a separate waist pack or pack. This short can fit an amazing amount of your essential items, allowing you to run without the need for a waist pack. Engineered using a technical melting yarn fabric for the outer short, which utilises 'pin prick' holes for optimised breathability, wicking and freedom of movement; whilst the inner short uses a comfort first fabric that is designed specifically with comfort and anti-chafe in mind. Our team designed the All Terrain short based on years of long hill days in all environments. This has led to a runner first short that allows you to store run essentials including soft flasks, phone, gels, run fuel, keys etc.

name: Men's Tech 7" Twin Short
shortDescription: Two layered short with a relaxed fitting outer and a supportive inner short built in. Designed for those that love our twin shorts but want a bit more coverage and support on their quads. 50 years of running has taught u...
description: Two layered short with a relaxed fitting outer and a supportive inner short built in. Designed for those that love our twin shorts but want a bit more coverage and support on their quads. 50 years of running has taught us that different runners want different things. Some like freedom of movement, some like support, and some like both. This 2-in-1 short offers the best of both worlds, without compromising one or the other. Made from our light, breathable, moisture-wicking, eco-conscious fabric, made from recycled yarn, the inner short has been carefully designed to provide support without constricting movement. The outer short has a relaxed fit and a secure pocket. Ventilated to keep you comfortable, the Tech 7” Twin short features reflective strips to help you to be seen. Always popular, they come a bit longer, for those wanting a bit more overage and support on their quads

name: Women's Tech Race Short
shortDescription: If any product symbolises the deep heritage we have in running this would be it. Ron first pioneered the split racing short when stood on the start line of a race over 55 years ago. Frustrated with the lack of freedom hi...
description: If any product symbolises the deep heritage we have in running this would be it. Ron first pioneered the split racing short when stood on the start line of a race over 55 years ago. Frustrated with the lack of freedom his shorts were giving him he ripped the sides of them so he could maximise his stride. What was a simple yet primitive solution at that race quickly became a defining classic product in our running movement. Ron took the ripped shorts and prototyped a proper racing version utilising his doctorate in textile chemistry and knowledge of synthetic fabrics to create an iconic product that is now symbolic of race day. Today’s race short is an evolution of that first design and pays tribute in every thread and design detail to what Ron created on that start line. What led Ron to perform to the highest of his powers also allows you to perform to your greatest potential. The Tech Race Short is our most technical race short. The ultralight Aeroweave fabric is a recycled polyester with elastane for great stretch and recovery. This fabric features a melting yarn, and this enables a mesh like structure to be formed during the manufacturing process which allows for complete airflow. The inner brief uses a super light recycled polyester knit fabric for support and breathability. The shape of the short features a completely open split at the side of the leg giving absolute freedom of movement. The side spilt is bonded for a light and clean finish. In effect the back panel stays in place and slightly wraps around to the front. The front panel is what moves with you as you stride. Storage is minimal as it should be on a racer short. The optimum solution is a small zip secure pkt for a key or card, and our gel loop system which can carry at least 2 gels. There are a different number of V shaped gel loops on each side to allow for any size of gel. We have tested a variety of brands and sizes, and all are compatible. To ensure a comfortable run we’ve selected a soft elastic that sits against the body, coupled with a continuous elastic drawcord that is flat, light and won’t get lost in the wash. Lastly, we have added discreet reflectivity on the back hem.
